name: Stu Brackney
bio: Stu Brackney is a Vietnam veteran who spent twenty-five years with the State of Arizona coordinating programs for deaf and hard of hearing people before becoming a sports announcer and touring motivational speaker. He has been a PAS member for nearly five years and President for two, and owns a Celestron SE 8" telescope. He especially enjoys PAS's Star Tours program, which shares the club's mission of educating the public about the stars, planets, and our expanding universe.
